pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark regions with moderately smooth edge gradients and minor fine-scale crenulation. Spatial area of patches is significantly larger than the intervening light-colored space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored inter-patch pathways. Topology consists primarily of 3-way and 4-way junction nodes. Pixel thickness is narrow and relatively uniform across the visible mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette visible along the upper neck segment, exhibiting a brush-like textural edge against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: A small, dark, localized mass, consistent with a perched bird (likely an oxpecker), is visible on the upper cervical dorsal ridge, partially occluding the mane profile.
